# Low Poly City Kit (Kit Cidade Low Poly)

> Free, public domain (CC0 1.0) pack of 129 low poly 3D models in glTF/GLB for building cities in games and
> visualizations: houses, shops, public services, water and sanitation, renewable energy, waste and recycling,
> parks, modular 2 × 2 road and terrain tiles, vehicles, street furniture, Brazilian native trees and riverside
> props. Flat colors, no textures, at most 1,500 triangles and 150 KB per model. Works in Godot, Unity (glTFast),
> Unreal Engine 5, three.js, Babylon.js and Blender. Commercial use allowed; attribution optional.

- Repository: https://github.com/kayquer/kit-cidade-lowpoly
- License: CC0 1.0 (public domain), see LICENSE
- Authors: Kayque Rotondo and Cláudia Dias Roxinol (see CITATION.cff)
- Format: binary glTF (.glb), Y up, front facing -Z, one PBR material per color (base color only)
- Scale: 1 lot = 2 × 2 units; buildings take N × N lots; road/terrain tiles are exactly 2 × 2 and rotate in 90° steps
- Animatable parts: objects named `pas_N` (rotors) and `gira_N` (spin upright) are separate, pivot in place
- Source: one Blender 4.5 Python script per model in `src/<category>/<id>.py`; shared helpers in `src/lib.py`
- File names are in Portuguese; English names below and in tools/nomes_en.json

## Docs

- [README (English)](https://github.com/kayquer/kit-cidade-lowpoly/blob/main/README.md): usage, tile measurements, catalog, FAQ
- [README (Português)](https://github.com/kayquer/kit-cidade-lowpoly/blob/main/README.pt-BR.md): mesma documentação em português
- [Model catalog JSON](https://github.com/kayquer/kit-cidade-lowpoly/blob/main/models/catalogo.json): id, category, triangles, KB, Portuguese description
